text:
kai: quick check — do we have an APAC A100 quota ETA? need it to run the dedicated-pool terraform CI and the demo next week :grimacing:

maria: @kai vendor replied this morning, shipping racks on their end but GCP quota approval is the blocker. procurement asked us to confirm exact reservation size (vCPU/GPU).

sam: for the terraform PR (https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/314) CI fails unless we can create a reservation of 8 A100s in ap-northeast1. can we reduce to 4 for the demo?

jess: reducing to 4 is fine for the demo, but perf/latency tests need 8. if quota only allows 4 we should gate the perf job and still run functional canaries.

maria: noted. I asked vendor to prioritize the manifest — they said EOD Tue for serials. GCP quota approval ETA depends on account team (I pinged our rep).

kai: ok sounds good. can someone post the minimal terraform diff so procurement knows exactly what to request?

sam: putting snippet here — this is what CI tries to apply:```hcl
resource "google_compute_reservation" "apac_a100" {
  name        = "redwood-apac-a100-resv"
  zone        = "ap-northeast1-a"
  count       = 8
  machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g"
}
```

maria: copying that to the ticket and to vendor chat. ticket: <https://tickets.company/INC-2345|INC-2345> — added note that we can accept 4 temporarily.

infra-bot: procurement update: vendor manifest expected 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC; GCP quota request submitted (req-98765), pending manual review.

jess: thanks @infra-bot. @maria once manifest is in could you post rack serials and whether those racks will be available to our on-prem pilot?

maria: will do. also fyi I'll open a small follow-up PR to gate the perf workflow so CI doesn't block on quota.

kai: sweet — if anyone can approve the gating PR today I can re-run CI and confirm the demo job passes with 4 GPUs. @sam can you leave a quick note on the PR about the temporary reduction? :thumbsup:

sam: on it. left comment explaining the rollback plan and a TODO to revert once quota is 8.

jess: approved the gating PR. :rocket:

kai: thanks team. I'll mark the demo as green if CI passes and log any perf deltas.

maria: follow-up: vendor confirmed shipping manifest will include rack IDs, sharing when I get them.

infra-bot: reminder: quota request req-98765 will escalate to our account team if not approved within 48h.

kai: perfect — closing loop here. if anything changes ping #eng-infra or DM me.
